entities.name: DCC amide coupling
observations: The carboxylic acid terminus of the protected peptide-like reactant is coupled with ethyl 2-amino-3-(p-tolyl)propanoate using DCC and triethylamine, forming a peptide amide bond.
Predicted product retains acetyl ester protections, benzyloxycarbonyl protection, and stereochemistry from both substrates.

entities.name: Query argininosuccinate synthase
observations: 410 aa protein sequence; exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt A6VVI2.
Closest reviewed annotations identify the protein as argininosuccinate synthase, EC 6.3.4.5.
Predicted Pfam domains: Arginosuc_synth PF00764, Arginosuc_syn_C PF20979; consistent with argininosuccinate synthase.
Expected localization is cytoplasmic and oligomeric state homotetramer, based on exact reviewed homolog.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 46.0 kDa and theoretical pI 5.12.

entities.name: Argininosuccinate synthesis
observations: L-citrulline + L-aspartate + ATP → 2-(Nω-L-arginino)succinate (argininosuccinate) + AMP + diphosphate + H+.
Reaction is mapped to Rhea RHEA:10932 and EC 6.3.4.5.

entities.name: L-arginine biosynthesis
observations: Argininosuccinate synthase catalyzes step 2 of 3 in bacterial L-arginine biosynthesis from L-ornithine and carbamoyl phosphate.
The enzyme is also annotated to the urea cycle in reviewed homologs.
